title: The Slow Orchard
author: Theo Thornbury
blurb: Orsen Blackwood, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
